messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Smart-routing anomaly: sustained inter-region failover loop detected for routing-policy `smart-fallback-v2`. Affected regions: us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Failover rate spike at 1754321980 (2200/min). Pager: on-call. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/region-fallback

alice: ack — alice (oncall). Paging eng-sre and eng-runtime. I'm taking lead triage.

bob: oncall-sre here, looking at traces now. Early notes: health-checks flipping between PASS/FAIL every ~25-40s across the 3 regions, causing successive cross-region failovers. KV cache churn observed on routing-proxy; increased miss rate.

carla: eng-runtime chiming in — saw a rollout to `gptx-ql-v2` in eu ~30m before alerts. Warmup hooks might not be returning healthy quickly; some instances are failing readiness causing region to report unhealthy.

bob: confirming — probe logs show probes hitting `/healthz` returning 503 intermittently from eu backend pool. Pattern: eu FAIL -> traffic to us-west -> us-west sees load -> begins failing -> traffic to us-east -> then back. Loop.

dave: sales note — AcmeCorp reported client errors and latency spikes starting ~15:02 UTC. They're on Dedicated clusters in eu and us-west.

liz: confirmed from support dashboard: AcmeCorp 5xx rate up 18% and p95 latency doubled. Multiple sessions timed out. Customers affected: acme-inc, fintech-beta, internal perf-suite.

alice: priority: mitigate customer impact fast. Options: 1) freeze cross-region failover (stop smart-fallback), 2) increase healthcheck debounce/threshold, 3) rollback model variant in eu. Which is lowest blast radius?

carla: rollback of `gptx-ql-v2` in eu is lowest blast radius for model-related cause. But if routing proxy is unstable, freezing policy is fastest and reversible. Recommend freeze first + rollback as precaution.

bob: agree. I'm going to apply a temporary policy to disable cross-region failover for 30m and set fallback to local-only. Applying change now.

bob: ```
# routing-policy temporary patch
policy: smart-fallback-v2
actions:
  - type: set_failover_mode
    value: local-only
  - type: set_debounce
    health_check_failures: 5
    health_check_window_sec: 120
```

deploy-bot: config-update: policy/smart-fallback-v2 patched by bob (commit: abc1234). CI checks passed.

bob: change applied and propagated to edge proxies. Monitoring for stabilization.

carla: initiating rollback of eu model variant to `gptx-ql-v1` on the eu pool. Rolling back via deployment group eu-models -> starting.

deploy-bot: rollout start: eu-models rollback to `gptx-ql-v1` (deploy id: deploy-9987).

bob: early signs: health-check fail rate dropping in eu, failover counts down 75% in last 60s. KV miss rate normalizing.

liz: AcmeCorp metrics improving (5xx down to baseline). Sending note to SEs to inform customers.

alice: thanks. Keeping incident open for postmortem. Please collect artifacts: probe logs, routing-proxy traces, model rollout history, config diffs. Assigning owners: bob (eng-sre) for routing/proxy, carla (eng-runtime) for model rollout root cause.

carla: collecting logs and will correlate with deploy timeline. suspect warmup / readiness hook timing regression in `gptx-ql-v2` rollout.

bob: capturing proxy pcap/traces, will run simulated failover test after cooldown.

alice: timeline so far: 1754321987 alert -> 1754322030 freeze policy -> 1754322105 model rollback trigger -> 1754322260 stabilization observed. We'll aim for mitigations to remain for 30m then cautiously re-enable smart-fallback.

dave: flagged internal customers on ACME support thread. Customers appreciated quick response.

bob: proposed long-term fixes: add more aggressive healthcheck debounce to avoid 30s flipflop, add probe-level scoring so single region flaps don't trigger global failover for X minutes, and add rollout canary warmup for model variants.

carla: will add a check to the model onboarding runbook to ensure readiness hooks meet 2x expected probe frequency during rollouts.

alice: will hand this to postmortem. Please put any links to logs/dashboards below. Closing action: keep policy frozen until postmortem complete.

bob: saving artifacts: https://internal.logs/redwood/1754321987/proxy-trace, https://dashboards.redwood/region-failovers?ts=1754322000, runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/region-fallback.

carla: model deploy diff: https://git.redwood/models/changeset/qlv2-rollback (commit: def567).

deploy-bot: deploy complete: eu-models rollback finished (deploy id: deploy-9987) at 1754322399.

alice: thanks everyone. I'm creating the outage incident ticket and assigning postmortem to bob + carla. Will update #incidents when draft ready. :thumbsup:
